question:
An engineer created a service profile in Cisco UCS Manager and associated it to a server. The engineer must create a policy if there is a disruptive change applied to the service profile.
Which policy type must be used to accomplish this goal?
theory: Any policy that determines how and when a disruptive change to an associated service profile is applied to its server — including whether the server reboots immediately, on a schedule, or only after user acknowledgment — is the maintenance policy. BIOS, administration, and 'reboot' (not a standalone UCS policy type on its own) policies address other configuration domains, so the maintenance policy is specifically the object created and attached to a service profile to control the impact of disruptive changes. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 12 — Cisco UCS Maintenance Policies)
